title: Greece Between Recovery and Reality: Inflation Relief Rings Hollow · 01 Sep
keywords: Greece, inflation, cost of living, primary surplus, wildfires, climate risk, eurozone, fiscal policy, household budgets, tourism, European Union, economic recovery
notes: Greece's government is pointing to a record primary surplus and easing inflation as proof that fiscal discipline is paying off for ordinary households. But critics argue the numbers flatter to deceive, with cumulative price pressures still biting and a summer of wildfires and heatwaves adding a new structural threat to the public finances. The country is emerging as a test case for how a post-crisis eurozone economy handles the twin pressures of persistent cost-of-living fatigue and accelerating climate risk.
